title: Guidelines for the Preparation of Detail Project Report (2021)
text:
Annexure D
Guidelines for the preparation of the Detail Project Report
(Publication)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The detail project report (DPR) should include the following information:
1. Details on the proposal
● Mission
● Objective
2. Product and Service
● Editorial policy
● Product and distribution plan
● Content coverage plan
3. Marketing Plan
● Sales forecast
● Advertisement and circulation
4. Management
● Management Board
● Editorial Board/Committee along with CV
● Percentage of shares owned by every member
5. Financial sustainability plan
● Source of revenue with evidence
● Revenue and cost forecast
